source.check: every name read from the page image; "no contest", no poll

note: Triennial election of the Castleblayney No. 2 (Crossmaglen) rural district council, polled 25 May 1905. Contests were due in Newtownhamilton (David Ardis, David Mitchell, Thomas N. M'Connell, James Thompson), Lisleitrim (Christopher Bellew, Peter John Bellew, Edward Sheridan), Cloghoge (John Grant, Alex. Johnston, Thomas Loughran) and Camly (Michael Collins, John Conaghy, F. M'Kenna, Wm. Preston); their results were not found. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. "No contest." A James Donaghey (of Corliss) was also returned for Cullyhanna.
